<module>.my_method.validated_on: Stanford bunny sampled to 20 000 points (examples/...), KITTI sweep; generated clouds in tests/test_ops_smoke.py

params.radius: 0.05 in file units is about 5x the point spacing of a centimetre-resolution scan: the covariance needs 10-30 points inside the radius; scale it with the spacing (0.5 mm for CBCT, 0.5 m for outdoor LiDAR).
params.max_nn: 30 neighbours cap the cost on dense clouds while keeping the estimate local at edges.
